parts.name: Packing Nut
parts.description: A brass packing nut that secures the stem assembly to the tap body.

parts.name: Wall Flange
parts.description: A circular steel flange that covers the wall entry point of the tap.

parts.name: Tap Body
parts.description: The main brass body of the tap that channels water flow.

parts.name: Handle
parts.description: A T-shaped brass handle at the top of the tap.

parts.name: Stem
parts.description: A brass stem that connects the handle to the washer assembly.

parts.name: Washer Seat
parts.description: A rubber washer seat located at the bottom of the stem inside the tap body.
